verdict.rationale: The product's core interface takes natural-language instructions. The Agent API accepts `instructions` and `input` as plain-language prompts (docs-29). Pro Search and built-in tools act on those prompts with multi-step searches, URL fetches and sandboxed code (docs-5, docs-30, docs-31). The Computer MCP server and Perplexity MCP server let an AI assistant delegate multi-step work to it in natural language (docs-55, docs-4, docs-18). missing for 10: natural-language control of the product itself (configuration, profiles, admin), which is still done through structured API parameters, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
